import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0]/A + p[1]*t**2/A + p[2] + p[3]*A + p[4]*A**2
            + p[5]/(1 + p[6]*A**2) + p[7]*A/(1 + p[8]*A**2) + p[9]*np.log(A))
